# T3 evals — Home rebuild (row 1 three tiles, row 2 SoonTile + AskCard)

Test file: tests/components/t3-home.test.tsx. Render `<RealHome />` under NEXT_PUBLIC_ADAPTERS=mock. Fixture A = facts with renewal_date "2027-03-14", policies=2, sum_insured=1000000. Fixture B = same minus renewal_date.

E1. Tile labels in order — test "row 1 labels in order", fixture A. Expect: DOM order of text nodes "Policies", "Sum insured", "Next renewal" (compareDocumentPosition ascending). PASS if all 3 found, in that order.

E2. Tile values — test "row 1 shows values", fixture A. Expect: Policies tile contains "2"; Sum insured tile contains "₹" and "10"; Next renewal tile contains a formatted date containing "2027". PASS if all three.

E3. Renewal missing — test "next renewal shows Not in your policy", fixture B. Expect: screen.getByText("Next renewal") present and screen.getByText("Not in your policy") inside the same tile; no "Invalid Date", no "undefined", no "null". PASS if so.

E4. Cover per person soon — test "cover per person is disabled soon tile". Expect: element containing text "Cover per person" has closest [aria-disabled="true"]. PASS if found.

E5. Ask prompts — test "ask card has two prompts". Expect: exactly 2 links with href starting "/chat?q=": text "What are my waiting periods?" and "What does my policy not cover?"; q param decodes to the same text. PASS if count === 2 and both texts match.

E6. No policy cards — test "no policy cards on Home". Expect: `container.querySelectorAll('[aria-label^="Policy"], [aria-label*="policy card" i]')` length 0 (use the exact aria-label pattern from src/components/cover-real policy card; grep it first). PASS if 0.

E7. One primary action — test "single primary CTA". Expect: elements matching `[data-variant="primary"], .btn-primary, button[class*="primary"]` count <= 1. PASS if <= 1.

E8. Symmetry — test "row 1 has 3 tiles; row 2 has 2 children". Expect: row 1 grid has 3 direct Tile children; row 2 BentoGrid has `split` (grid-template-columns 1.3fr 1fr via class/prop) with 2 children. PASS if so.

E9. No sample names — cmd: `grep -cE 'Meera|Rohan|Kabir|Mumma|Papa' src/components/cover-real/RealHome.tsx` — expect: 0 (grep exits 1 with count 0). PASS if count is 0.

E10. Uses primitives — cmd: `grep -c "from \"@/components/ui\"" src/components/cover-real/RealHome.tsx` — expect: >= 1. PASS if >= 1.

E11. Tokens locked — cmd: `git diff -U0 src/styles/tokens.css | grep -E '^[+-][^+-]' | grep -vE -- '--bento-gap|--tile-pad'` — expect: no output. PASS if empty (only --bento-gap 12px and --tile-pad 16px added).

E12. Full gate — cmd: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` — expect: exit 0. PASS if exit 0.
